ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used for an optional formatted content anchor id.

DetailBasePath.helper: Enter the detail base path to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

DefaultPageSize.helper: Enter a number for default page size. Use a value that fits the choices and layout shown on the page.

ShowTopCategories.helper: Turn this setting on or off to control show top categories.

ShowTopTags.helper: Turn this setting on or off to control show top tags.

ShowTopOrganizers.helper: Turn this setting on or off to control show top organizers.

RelatedEventCount.helper: Enter a number for related event count. Use a value that fits the choices and layout shown on the page.

ShowRelatedEvents.helper: Turn this setting on or off to control show related events.

ShowAudiences.helper: Turn this setting on or off to control show audiences.

ShowFeatures.helper: Turn this setting on or off to control show features.
